source: independent validator agent; direct full primary re-fetch, full PDF extraction, sentence-level audit
rejected: This five-metro draft expands deliveries around Dallas: The FAA names Amarillo, Austin, El Paso, Houston and San Antonio; Dallas is not included in this draft.

The draft identifies AI cameras or computer vision as the delivery-site evaluation mechanism: Full independently fetched 194-page PDF contains no artificial intelligence or computer vision description. It describes automatic evaluation and an image sent to an operator; camera/model specificity is not established by this draft.

An unclear image automatically goes to an operator: The exact condition is inability to automatically identify the target and evaluate its suitability; the draft does not specify an image-clarity trigger.

The five-metro expansion is approved or successfully operating: Current FAA page seeks approval and comments on a draft environmental assessment. Proposed operations are not demonstrated rollout results.
Every attempted delivery succeeds without human oversight: The draft explicitly provides operator escalation and retraction when evaluation criteria fail. No measured success rate has been verified.
A failed delivery sends the package back to the merchant: The evidence establishes retraction into the aircraft, not the subsequent destination of that payload.
